_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: an Xbox project is one DVD image. The machine can also boot straight to its dashboard from the hard disk, so the disc is optional - an empty tray is a valid machine.

slots.title: Disc
slots.help: The game disc as an xiso image (.iso). Leave it empty and the machine boots to its dashboard from the hard disk image instead - the tray is simply open.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the hard disk starts with already saved: per-title Xbox save games, under UDATA/<titleId>/<save>/. These are the files Emulator > Export Save Data... writes, put back under the exact same relative paths. Each is mounted read-only and pinned by hash and the movie cites it, so a movie that starts from a saved game is as reproducible as one that starts from a blank disk. A name the machine does not read there (anything not under UDATA/) is refused rather than silently dropped.
